metadata.inclusion:
1. Plug the Power Strip into a grounded receptacle
2. Click CH1 button 3 times quickly
3. All LED indicators will start flashing to confirm inclusion
metadata.exclusion: Press and release the CH1 button 3 times quickly. All LED indicators will flash to confirm exclusion.
metadata.reset: Click-click-click'n'hold CH1 button for at least 10 seconds. All LED indicators will flash to confirm successful reset.

metadata.description: Enables control through the physical inputs on the device
